page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, this instance provides dedicated physical execution units without hyperthreading, ensuring predictable compute performance.

The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local NVMe storage or onboard GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfers for network-bound operations.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.r8i.4xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require substantial memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreading. This hardware profile is well-suited for memory-intensive applications, including in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and medium-scale data processing pipelines.
